title: ttf-metaphlan pipeline parameters
description: Shotgun Taxonomic Profiling (MetaPhlAn 4) for TreeTopFlow. Research use only. Not for clinical or diagnostic use.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output files.

input.description: Path to comma-separated samplesheet with columns sample,fastq_1,fastq_2. fastq_2 may be empty for single-end data.
input.help_text: The samplesheet must have a header row. Paired-end rows set both FASTQ paths; single-end rows leave fastq_2 blank.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved. You can use an S3 path with the awsbatch profile.

metadata.description: Optional sample metadata TSV. The first column must be ID or sample and match samplesheet sample IDs. Used as phyloseq sample_data.
metadata.help_text: Leave unset to build phyloseq without sample metadata.

reference_options.title: Reference databases
reference_options.description: MetaPhlAn 4 and host-removal Bowtie2 indexes. Defaults on refdb.treetopunder.com will be wired once uploaded.

metaphlan_db.description: MetaPhlAn 4 database directory or .tar/.tar.gz archive (target index mpa_vJun23_CHOCOPhlAnSGB_202403). Default on refdb.treetopunder.com will be wired once uploaded.
metaphlan_db.help_text: Provide an unpacked directory containing MetaPhlAn Bowtie2 index files, or a tar/tar.gz archive that will be unpacked with nf-core/untar.

host_index.description: Host Bowtie2 index directory or .tar/.tar.gz archive (GRCh38_noalt_as). Required unless --skip_host_removal. Default on refdb.treetopunder.com will be wired once uploaded.
host_index.help_text: Directory of *.bt2/*.bt2l files, or a tar/tar.gz archive unpacked with nf-core/untar. Host-aligned BAM/reads are never published.

skip_host_removal.description: Skip Bowtie2 host-read removal and send trimmed reads directly to MetaPhlAn.

analysis_options.title: Analysis options
analysis_options.description: MetaPhlAn analysis type, QC, and optional reports.

min_read_len.description: fastp --length_required minimum read length after trimming.
